agent_pane.lead_name_hint: The lead goes by your wake word; change it in the voice settings.
agent_pane.seat_hint: Change the model here or in the chat's + menu. The runtime stays the same for the agent's whole life.
agent_pane.memory_detail: What it knows about you and its work
agent_pane.skills_hint: Playbooks it wrote for itself after finished work. It uses them when the situation matches.
agent_pane.files_hint: Its work folder here, and its notes in the wiki.
agent_pane.reach_all_hint: It may use every connected tool except the ones you block. Tools marked to reach first come first.
agent_pane.reach_allowlist_hint: It uses only the tools switched on below.
agent_pane.lead_tools_hint: The lead uses every tool the app's own settings allow.
agent_pane.tools_unavailable: The tool list is unavailable right now. Your saved choices are unchanged.
agent_pane.rules_hint: Use a tool id such as plugin:gmail, or a single action such as plugin:gmail:send.
agent_pane.browser_own_hint: A separate browser profile that only this agent uses.
agent_pane.browser_attach_hint: It works in your running Chrome, with your sign-ins.
agent_pane.placement_hint: These two save right away and apply from its next reply.
agent_pane.widen_reach_all: It may use every connected tool, not only the ones you picked.
agent_pane.widen_browser: It works in your own Chrome, with your sign-ins.
agent_pane.widen_sites_any: Its browser may open any site.
agent_pane.leave_sandbox_body: Outside the sandbox this agent works with this computer's files, shell and network again.
agent_pane.review_seeded: A message is ready in the chat.
agent_pane.review_chat_seed: Please walk me through what you learned or proposed that is still waiting for my review, one item at a time, and ask me about each.

browser_takeover.requested: The agent asks you to take over its browser
browser_takeover.private_hint: You are in control. What you type goes only to the page: it is not logged and the agent never sees it.
browser_takeover.handed_back: Handed back. The agent knows which page you left it on.
browser_takeover.handed_back_typed: Handed back. The agent knows which page you left it on, not what you typed.

browser_profiles.preview_paused: Sign in directly in Chrome. Dodaios pauses the preview while you control this profile. Return control when you are finished.
browser_profiles.chrome_limits: Agents control only their own tab on the allowed websites. File uploads, downloads and switching your other Chrome tabs are not supported yet.
browser_profiles.title: Browser profiles
browser_profiles.intro: A browser profile keeps your website logins. Agents browse with it, so they stay signed in.
browser_profiles.persistence: Logins and choices stay on this computer, also after a restart. A website can still log you out.
browser_profiles.name: Profile name
browser_profiles.domains_hint: Agents may only open these websites in your Chrome. Separate them with commas.
browser_profiles.managed_domains_hint: Leave empty to allow every website Dodaios permits.
browser_profiles.busy_error: The browser is in use. Finish the current browser task or release manual control, then try again.
browser_profiles.save_error: Could not save this change. Check the profile name and website domains, then try again.
browser_profiles.load_error: Could not load browser profiles. Try refreshing.
browser_profiles.extension_preview: Chrome connection preview: the extension is installed manually until Chrome Web Store distribution is available.
browser_profiles.unpack: Unpack the ZIP into a folder you will keep.
browser_profiles.install: In the Chrome profile you want to share, open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, and select that folder.
browser_profiles.pair_hint: Open the Dodaios extension in that Chrome profile. Enter the server address and a new pairing code below, then connect. Refresh status here afterwards.
browser_profiles.code_expiry: Valid for {0} minutes. Keep this code private; it connects this Chrome profile to Dodaios.
browser_profiles.code_expired: The pairing code expired. Generate a new code to connect.
browser_profiles.no_agents: No agents yet. You can assign this profile after creating an agent.
browser_profiles.remove_hint: This removes the profile from Dodaios. Saved logins on this computer are not deleted.
browser_profiles.empty: No profile yet. Open an agent's browser and Dodaios creates the shared browser automatically.
browser_profiles.disconnected: Chrome disconnected. Open the correct Chrome profile, connect its Dodaios extension, then refresh. Browser tasks wait for this connection.
browser_profiles.google_signin_recovery: Google can reject sign-in in an automated browser. Sign in yourself in regular Chrome first, then connect that Chrome profile here and explicitly choose it for this agent.
browser_profiles.inline_login_not_ready: Regular Chrome is not ready — Sign in can retry
browser_profiles.takeover_stops_task: Taking control stops this browser task and opens regular Chrome here.
browser_profiles.inline_login_hint: Sign in here in Chrome. When finished, hand this profile back to the agent. Your browser profile is saved on this computer.
browser_profiles.inline_login_recovery: Choose Sign in to reopen this profile in regular Chrome inside this window, with agent control disconnected during sign-in.
browser_profiles.inline_login_unavailable: This session cannot open sign-in yet. It requires installed Google Chrome and a current Windows browser session.
browser_profiles.how_shared: Dodaios' own browser profile. Every agent uses it unless you choose something else. Sign in once and every agent is signed in.
browser_profiles.how_sign_in: Open an agent's browser, choose Sign in, log in to the website, then choose Hand back to agent.
browser_profiles.how_own: An empty profile that only one agent uses, for example for a second account.
browser_profiles.how_chrome: Connects a profile from your regular Chrome with a small extension. Agents may only open the websites you allow.
browser_profiles.agent_needs_choice: The profile this agent used was removed. Choose a profile so it can browse again.
browser_profiles.use_shared_hint: {0} — the same logins as all other agents. Recommended.
browser_profiles.no_shared: No shared profile is set up. Choose another option.
browser_profiles.own_hint: Separate logins that only this agent uses.
browser_profiles.managed_profile_hint: Separate Dodaios browser with its own logins.
browser_profiles.used_by_all: Used by all agents and new agents
browser_profiles.used_by_none: Not used by any agent yet
browser_profiles.default_usage: Every agent uses this profile unless you choose another one for it. New agents get it automatically.
browser_profiles.make_default_confirm: Every agent switches to {0}, also agents with their own choice. New agents get it too.
browser_profiles.pick_agents_hint: Agents you untick stop browsing until you choose another profile for them.
browser_profiles.remove_default_hint: This is the shared profile. After removing it, agents cannot browse until you choose a profile for each of them. Saved logins on this computer are not deleted.
browser_profiles.new_managed_hint: An empty browser for a second account. You sign in once inside Dodaios.
browser_profiles.new_chrome_hint: Uses the logins you already have in Chrome. Needs a small extension.

profile_card.runtime_pending: The learning update will be available after the next app start. Your existing memory files remain readable.
profile_card.learned_hint: AI reviews completed conversations for useful lessons. These rules improve the next run while your instructions and permissions stay in force.
profile_card.review_waiting: Waiting for a completed conversation to review
profile_card.review_dropped: The last learning review was dropped after {0} tries. The next finished conversation gets a new one.
profile_card.review_reason_api_key_seat: A subscription is connected, so this agent's API key ({provider}) is not charged for learning from its chats. Put the agent on a subscription or local model so it can learn.
profile_card.review_reason_no_seat: The agent's model cannot be reached in this app right now.
profile_card.review_reason_seat_failed: The agent's model did not give a usable answer.
profile_card.knowledge_hint: Each agent maintains its own USER.md for your profile and preferences, and MEMORY.md for project knowledge and experience. Skills and conversation archives stay separate.
profile_card.subtitle: Agent profile
profile_card.name: Name
profile_card.instructions_hint: These standing instructions describe the agent’s job and behavior. Changes apply to subsequent runs.
profile_card.save_error: Could not save. Your changes are still here.
profile_card.sample_hint: Sample profile — editing and live memory are unavailable.
profile_card.empty: This agent has no memory files yet.

conversations.label: Conversations
conversations.hint: Where this agent works on what {name} or a teammate sent it, kept apart from your chat.

routine_detail.historical_chat: This older execution was stored in the agent's main chat. Only this execution is shown here, read-only.
routine_detail.trace_unavailable: No matching chat transcript is available for this execution. Its saved result is shown below when available.
routine_detail.delete_confirm: Delete this routine, all its schedules and execution history?
routine_detail.name: Name
routine_detail.model_follows_agent: Runs on the agent's current model. Pick one to pin this routine to it.
routine_detail.legacy: Older execution: result available; final status was not recorded.

chat.memory_change_legend: Green: added · Red: removed. This shows the saved change; the current file may have newer updates.
chat.memory_file_failed: Could not load the memory file
chat.memory_file_on_disk: Shown with the change highlighted; the file above is the version on disk.
chat.model_no_matches: No matching models. Connect a provider or refresh the list.
chat.model_scope: Applies to this agent's next messages and routine runs. Chat history stays.
chat.model_busy: Wait for the current response before changing models.
chat.model_load_failed: Could not load connected providers. Close and try again.
chat.model_connections: Only connected providers are listed. Add connections in Settings.

hooks.rotate_confirm: Replace the token? Existing integrations will need the new token.
hooks.remote: External services need a reachable HTTPS address for this Dodaios instance.
hooks.auth: Send JSON with Authorization: Bearer <token>. Reuse Idempotency-Key when retrying. For GitHub, use this token as the webhook Secret (HMAC-SHA256).
hooks.filter_hint: Example: {"data.status": "ready"}. Leave {} to accept every payload.

triggers.credentials_hint: Credentials are configured after saving, in Source connection.
triggers.accepted: Input queued. Results will appear in the agent chat.

groups.external: When something happens in a service
groups.system: When something changes on this computer

kinds.every: Every few minutes, hours or days
kinds.at_time: Once, at a date and time
kinds.webhook: When a web address is called
kinds.on_event: When the app reports an event
kinds.workflow_activated: When a workflow is switched on

entry.mcp: Available to configured MCP clients as routine_invoke.
entry.workflow: Waiting for the configured upstream event.

triggers.filtered: Input did not match the filters.

browser_live.restart_hint: Stops this browser task and reopens the saved profile. Unsaved page input may be lost.
browser_live.restart_failed: Could not restart the browser. Try again.
browser_live.off_hint: The browser starts only when {0} needs it.
browser_live.moved: The shared browser is open for {0} now. It can only be open for one agent at a time.
browser_live.busy_task: {0} is using the shared browser for a task. It opens here as soon as {0} is done.
browser_live.error_image: Browser image could not be decoded
browser_live.error_queue_full: Waiting for browser control; input queue is full

share.cta_hint: Turn this agent into a template others can install
share.title: Share {agent}
share.subtitle: A template of this agent's job, instructions and look — without anything private.
share.summary_placeholder: What this agent does, and for whom — one or two sentences.
share.polish_hint: {agent} rewrites its own instructions for anyone and writes the summary. You see it happen in the chat.
share.polish_waiting: {agent} is writing the public version — watch it in the chat. This sheet updates by itself.
share.polish_unavailable: Open this agent's chat to let it prepare the template itself.
share.polish_failed: The message could not be sent. Try again from the chat.
share.polish_prompt: Please prepare your shareable template for the Dodaios marketplace. Write a one- or two-sentence summary for the store card, and rewrite your standing instructions so anyone can use them: keep the working method, and remove everything personal — names, e-mail addresses, companies, folders, accounts — and every credential. Save it with the society_share_template tool, then tell me in one sentence that it is ready.
share.reset: Back to the agent's own text
share.privacy_clean_hint: No keys, passwords, e-mail addresses, phone numbers or folders of yours are in the template.
share.never_body: Your model and accounts, chats, memory, files and folders, connected computers, budget and approval settings stay on this computer. Whoever installs the template runs it on their own model, and it asks them before it acts.
share.sign_in: Sign in with GitHub to publish
share.publish_hint: Publishing lists it in the marketplace under your GitHub name. Automated checks run first; nobody has to approve it.
share.publish_disabled: Publishing is switched off in this install — export the file instead.
share.published_before: Version {version} is already published. Publishing again releases the next version.
share.submitted_body: The marketplace checks it now and lists it within a few minutes.
share.live_body: Anyone can install it now — with the line below, or from the marketplace.
share.fallback_hint: GitHub did not take the submission from the app. Copy the template and file it in your browser instead — it takes one paste.

list.empty_body: Jobs this agent runs on its own, like a morning digest or a weekly check.
list.when_unclear: Not sure when that is. Try “every Monday at 9” or “every 2 hours”.

parking.title: Paused: results went unread
parking.body: {count} routines made {unread} results in {days} days and none were opened. They stay paused until you resume them, so no runs are wasted.
parking.body_one: This routine made {unread} results in {days} days and none were opened. It stays paused until you resume it, so no runs are wasted.

away.label: Pause routines whose results go unread
away.hint: Applies to scheduled routines of every agent. Runs you start yourself are never paused.

detail.failed_no_detail: The run failed without an error message.
detail.delete_note: Future runs stop. Results already delivered stay in the agent's chat.

runs.empty: No runs yet. Use Test run to try it now.
runs.skip_away: Skipped: nobody opened the results for a while, so the routine was paused.

webhook.url_help: POST JSON to this address to start the routine.
webhook.key_help: Keep it secret. Rotate it if it ever leaks.
webhook.header_help: Paste this line into the sending service's request headers.
